definitions.short: Tsuph or Tsophai or Tsiph , the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H6689. Tsuph II. צוּף noun masculine Ephraim ancestor of Elkanah and Samuel , ׳בֶּןצֿ 1Sam 1:1 ( ἐν Νασειβ , ᵐ5 L υιὁῦ Σωφ ), 1Chr 6:20 Qr ᵑ9 ᵐ5 (Kt ציף ); apparently = צוֺפַי v. 6:11 (Levite), Σουφ ( ει ): hence probably צוּף אֶרֶץ 1Sam 9:5 (in Benjamin, τὴν ( γὴν ) Σ ( ε ) ιφ ( α )). צוּפִי adjective, of a people Suphite ; — so read probably for צוֺפִים 1Sam 1:1 (We Klo Dr and most modern, after ᵐ5 Σ ( ε ) ιφα , A Σωφιμ ).

occurrences.englishText: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.
When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant who was with him, “Come! Let’s return, lest my father stop caring about the donkeys, and be anxious for us.”
Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
